name: Tareq Monower Tamim
title: WordPress & Frontend Developer
bio: Hi, I'm Tareq, and thank you for visiting my profile! I graduated with a B.Sc. in Electrical & Electronic Engineering from the University of Chittagong in 2024. For the past 3-4 years, I've worked as a WordPress and Front-end Developer on platforms like Fiverr and PeoplePerHour. My skills include building and designing WordPress websites, creating custom themes and plugins, and front-end development using React.js, Next.js, Tailwind, and REST API. I also develop mobile apps with React Native and Firebase. I'm passionate about delivering high-quality digital solutions and always improving my skills to offer the best service. I look forward to working with you!
